name: Alice Walton

notes: Foundation data from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API (IRS extract), FY2023 990-PF: fair market value of assets $4,399,184,837 (book total assets $4,045,996,103); contributions/grants paid $94,958,378; total expenses $128,346,451; contributions received $160,640,000; 'distributable amount' field $189,186,922 and 'undistributed income' field $143,428,156 for 2023, but the 990-PF allows distribution through the following year and the filing's 'undistributed income subject to tax' checkbox is N, so met5PercentMinimum is left null (needs line-by-line PDF check: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/download-filing?path=IRS%2F823700633_202312_990PF_2025010222971656.pdf). IRS BMF shows tax period 2024-12 assets $4,688,592,870 (not yet a parsed 990-PF). Prior years grants paid: 2022 $95.2M (FMV assets $3.65B), 2021 $37.4M ($4.01B), 2020 $16.9M ($3.38B, year of $2.79B contribution in), 2019 $28.7M. Separate vehicle: Walton Family Foundation Inc, EIN 13-3441466, Bentonville AR (family foundation, not solely Alice's) — https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/133441466. Political 2024: Arkansas Times (citing OpenSecrets) reported Alice Walton gave 'more than $10 million' in the 2024 cycle; the article page returned empty on fetch, figure comes from the search snippet — needs-check against opensecrets.org. Not on Giving Pledge signatory list (checked 2026-07-29 version of list). Forbes 'Last Updated Sep 15, 2026' notes Alice L. Walton School of Medicine (Bentonville) admitted first class in 2025 and Crystal Bridges Museum opened 2011.
